characters.name: Itho Pel
characters.description: A junior scribe of the Counting Halls who copies mortal accounts and notices errors his seniors prefer to overlook.
characters.motivation: To see the soul weighed against what it actually did.
characters.goal: Get the miscast entry corrected and triple-sealed before the weighing.
characters.flaw: He trusts ink more than people, and says so.
characters.internal_conflict: Correcting the ledger means accusing the offices that feed him.
characters.external_conflict: The weighers' collegium bars a junior scribe from the scales.

abilities.name: Fault-sight
abilities.description: Spots a mis-tallied column at a glance, the way a proof-reader spots a dropped letter.

characters.arc: Itho learns that a correction is only ink until three unwilling hands agree to seal it.

characters.name: Dame Ors
characters.description: A senior weigher of the collegium who certified the miscast harvest of tallies and guards the scales' reputation as her own.
characters.motivation: To protect the weighers' infallibility, on which the whole court rests.
characters.goal: Quash the audit and weigh the soul as written.
characters.internal_conflict: She knows the column is wrong and has convinced herself the error is small.
characters.external_conflict: Itho's correction would put her seal beside the error.

abilities.name: Scale-craft
abilities.description: Reads a soul's weight to the last dram and detects a doctored balance.

characters.arc: Dame Ors must choose between the scales' honesty and her own.

characters.name: Hemo Lux
characters.description: A lamplighter archivist who tends the sealed stacks and remembers the index of every ledger he is forbidden to read.
characters.motivation: To keep the archive honest without breaking his lamp oath.
characters.goal: Produce the matching archive entry without reading a sealed page.
characters.flaw: He hides behind procedure when courage would serve better.
characters.internal_conflict: His oath protects the dead but shelters the fraud.
characters.external_conflict: Dame Ors threatens his lamp if he assists the audit.

abilities.name: Index memory
abilities.description: Recalls the position and cross-references of any sealed ledger without opening it.

characters.arc: Hemo risks his lamp to give the correction its third key.

relationships.description: Hemo's index can find the matching entry that proves the miscast.
relationships.conflict: Helping Itho puts Hemo's lamp in jeopardy.

relationships.description: Dame Ors certified the harvest of tallies Itho is auditing.
relationships.conflict: Her seal is required for the correction she wants buried.
